name: sdx
description: Spec-Driven Development framework: session lifecycle (/sdx:start … /sdx:archive), project audit (/sdx:audit), role subagents (ba, architect, lead-dev, developer, qa, reviewer, auditor, tech-writer, devops), a single stage scale with two mode flags (no_code / no_gates), and a deterministic enforcement layer guarding the irreversible (stop-gate, prod-guard, archive-verify) with a self-test proving the layer is alive; interop with a meta-orchestrator over the stands (vendored sim-kit leaf-session tools, .mesh/ mailbox, exec_paths hook).
